description: Defines the DisplayInfo class for a plugin, including nested Notification class, interface implementations, and methods for initialization, deinitialization, and request processing.

classes.name: DisplayInfo
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing plugin, web, and JSONRPC interfaces, managing display information and connection notifications.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling connection property notifications and remote connection events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
